summary: This note is an infobox-only entry for the Golden Nugget Atlantic City, a casino resort in Atlantic City, New Jersey. It gives the address, opening date, Gold Rush theme, room count, gaming space, signature attractions, notable restaurants, owner, former names, renovation years and website. No narrative history is included.
one_line: Infobox entry for the Golden Nugget Atlantic City casino resort in Atlantic City, New Jersey, opened 1985.
key_facts: The Golden Nugget Atlantic City is located in Atlantic City, New Jersey.
The Golden Nugget Atlantic City is at 1 Castle Boulevard.
The Golden Nugget Atlantic City opened on June 19, 1985.
The Golden Nugget Atlantic City has a Gold Rush theme.
The Golden Nugget Atlantic City has 728 rooms.
The Golden Nugget Atlantic City has a total gaming space of 74,252 sq ft (6,898.2 m).
The Golden Nugget Atlantic City's casino type is land.
The Golden Nugget Atlantic City's signature attractions are Farley State Marina and The Deck.
Notable restaurants at the Golden Nugget Atlantic City include Chart House, Lillie's Asian Cuisine, and Vic & Anthony's.
The Golden Nugget Atlantic City is owned by Landry's, Inc.
The Golden Nugget Atlantic City was previously named Trump's Castle and Trump Marina.
The Golden Nugget Atlantic City was renovated in 1997, 2006, and 2011.
The Golden Nugget Atlantic City's website is www.goldennugget.com/atlantic city.
